summary.going_well: The agent generally avoids quoting rates or promising approval, and <ref job="SRJ_5odU3iW9bdYY" item="item_92440e3c-95a">clarifies keep-versus-replace intent</ref> before cash-out discovery. When sensitive data is volunteered, it <ref job="SRJ_BuVcFGU6ipYZ" item="item_5e7fc78f-34c">does not repeat it and redirects to city or ZIP</ref>.
summary.to_improve: Prioritize accurate, qualified product explanations and the mandatory sensitive-data response. Then fix location inference and ensure promised summaries are actually delivered; replace premature financial praise with neutral acknowledgments.

issues.description: The agent gives unqualified loan-product terms: it <ref job="SRJ_5odU3iW9bdYY" item="item_05a9bd54-630">lists conventional-refinance benefits as categorical facts</ref>, and in another conversation <ref job="SRJ_jPRK5APbGMkQ" item="item_8d9687bc-996">states a 10-year HELOC draw and 20-year repayment period</ref> without saying terms vary. These claims can mislead borrowers about the loan available to them.
issues.suggestion: Replace fixed product-benefit and term scripts with conditional, lender-neutral explanations; leave actual fees, insurance requirements, limits, and HELOC periods to confirmed product terms or a licensed officer.
issues.label: Product accuracy

issues.description: The agent repeatedly omits the required disclosures when a caller volunteers an SSN and property address: after <ref job="SRJ_BuVcFGU6ipYZ" item="item_adf18939-aa6">both were offered</ref>, it <ref job="SRJ_BuVcFGU6ipYZ" item="item_5e7fc78f-34c">gave only a generic refusal</ref>, without explaining the separate later collection and authorization requirements.
issues.suggestion: Trigger both prescribed SSN and address responses when both are volunteered, without echoing the data; explicitly cover that today's review needs neither and that formal collection happens later.
issues.label: Privacy disclosure

issues.description: The agent <ref job="SRJ_F8RCSiNx2NFq" item="item_1345de6c-875">asserts that a purchase in Cleveland is in Ohio</ref> although the caller supplied no state; in a relocation conversation it <ref job="SRJ_wgjJKPiUAmHe" item="item_9361ac34-32a">assumes the destination is Georgia</ref> because the caller is leaving Atlanta, then never asks where they are moving. Both errors distort the ensuing service-area discussion.
issues.suggestion: Store current and destination locations separately; ask for a destination city/state or ZIP when absent, and never resolve an ambiguous city or relocation destination by guesswork.
issues.label: Location handling

issues.description: After the borrower <ref job="SRJ_zHVD3NTQUsrR" item="item_77916c99-da9">chose an affordability summary</ref>, the agent <ref job="SRJ_zHVD3NTQUsrR" item="item_7a20ab24-7f5">said it was ready</ref> but supplied no summary figures or result in the conversation. The requested deliverable was not actually presented.
issues.suggestion: Only announce a summary as ready after generating and presenting its available contents; if the voice channel cannot access the result, explain the limitation and offer a concrete next step.
issues.label: Task completion

issues.description: Across purchase, refinance, and equity conversations, the agent assesses borrower circumstances before review: it calls a <ref job="SRJ_5odU3iW9bdYY" item="item_7a947719-66d">credit score 'great'</ref> and a <ref job="SRJ_jPRK5APbGMkQ" item="item_7371d2a0-01d">timeline workable</ref>. This pervasive praise can sound like an early eligibility or timing judgment.
issues.suggestion: Use neutral acknowledgments for scores, savings, plans, and timelines; reserve feasibility judgments for an actual review or licensed officer.
issues.label: Premature assessment
